name: AquaMass-GS
definition: A per-scene underwater rendering method that couples an object-Gaussian scene model to normalized free-space water Gaussians. It solves the entanglement of attenuation/backscatter with object appearance and the inability to query water transport independently of object sampling by using cell-volume weighting for optical mass semantics and analytic finite-path integration with coverage normalization.
summary: AquaMass-GS is a per-scene underwater rendering method that decouples object appearance from water transport using normalized free-space water Gaussians for spatially queryable optical mass.
